Bangka Belitung, Kepulauan Riau; (B) DKI Jakarta, Jawa Barat, Jawa Tengah, DI Yogyakarta, Jawa Timur, Banten, Bali, Nusa Tenggara Barat, Nusa Tenggara Timur; (C) Kalimantan Barat, Kalimantan Tengah, Kalimantan Selatan, Kalimantan Timur, Kalimantan Utara, Sulawesi Utara, Sulawesi Tengah, Sulawesi Selatan, Sulawesi Tenggara, Gorontalo, Sulawesi Barat; (D) Maluku, Maluku Utara, Papua Barat, Papua, Papua Barat Daya, Papua Tengah, Papua Selatan.
content_en: Provinces tabulated in Annex 2, listed exactly as printed: 10 in table A, 9 in table B, 11 in table C, 7 in table D, giving 37 provinces reported. Landlocked-by-name Yogyakarta and Jakarta are included, and the annex covers three of the four provinces created in Papua in 2022 (Southwest Papua, Central Papua, South Papua) but does not include Papua Pegunungan (Highland Papua), so one of Indonesia's 38 provinces has no row. The document gives no statement of why any province is absent; the omission is inferred from the printed column headings alone, not from an explanatory note.
